content.study:
Section 43E — Vacancies not to invalidate proceedings

Section 43E provides that specified vacancies or defects in the constitution of the Council do not by themselves invalidate acts or proceedings undertaken under the Act.

Part IA provisions concerning the Arbitration Council of India must be read with the commencement and implementation status of the relevant provisions and subordinate legislation.
